_note: Operation zones (docs/combined_arms.md 6.2, phase D1; OperationGen, ZoneDef.generate_operation). Distances along the axis of advance are metres from the friendly edge (or the sea); lateral ones from the axis's middle line. 'bands' end at their 'to_m'. Sites per zone ('sites') as hot zones generate them, scaled: outposts and checkpoints spread over the bands by 'band_share' (the crossing band gets the bridge's far-bank checkpoint and one outpost), the HQ, its comms site and QRF bases in the depth band. 'msr': where the main supply route runs; 'river': the band-2 river (ZoneWater's hint: 'water' is merged into the preset's water spec); 'crossings': where the steel truss route and the ford tracks cross (lateral metres apart). 'landmark_bands': the band each landmark kind goes in (ZoneModules.place_landmarks); 'depth_targets': the first of these the covered zones bring is the depth target, else 'depth_fallback' is added. 'terrain': the presets an operation takes from its covered zones, by region, the first that exists the fallback. All Proposed.
_city_note: cg_brief 3.1: an operation of these types fights for a city (BuildingGen.city_layout, cghath's queue item 1.5) where the town module would stand; the MSR comes in at its ring street on the bridge's side and leaves on the far side. Proposed.
_town_start_note: cg_brief 3.3 (D5): an operation of these types starts in its town (the company is its new garrison): the insertion and extraction points on the city's ring street where the MSR comes in (else 80 m short of the town module). Proposed.
_streaming_note: D2 (docs/combined_arms.md 6.2.2-6.2.3; BigZoneStreaming; cg_brief 3.1): zones of 'from_size_m' or more stream their ground on every peer: terrain collision chunks within 'collision_in_m' of any player, 'vehicle_in_m' of a vehicle and 'soldier_in_m' of any other live soldier ('engaged_in_m' on the host for one whose squad is in a fight), freed past 'collision_out_m' x reach / collision_in_m; the scatter's cover by its cells the same way ('scatter_in_m', 'scatter_out_m'). Planned every 'tick_s', built every physics frame for 'frame_ms' (nearest first, at least one of each); a player or vehicle that appears gets 'ensure_m' at once. The scatter's caps grow with the zone's area over 'scatter_area_km2' (a hot zone's density held). Soldiers drawn to 'soldier_draw_m', vehicles to 'vehicle_draw_m' as a box past 'vehicle_proxy_m'. The Virtualizer holds profiles back (past its FORCE_M) while 'live_soldiers' are live, rides while 'live_vehicles' are. All Proposed.
